LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_HypnoticTrance.label: (Raven) Hypnotic Command Executing
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_HypnoticTrance.description: An external terminal has completely hijacked this person's subconscious. Their body is forced to carry out humiliating sexual acts like a puppet. Their mind remains fully conscious, but they cannot control a single muscle.\n\n"My body... it's so hot... I can't stop..."
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Debuff.label: (Raven) Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Debuff.description: Severing the deep hypnosis link overloads the nervous system, causing a massive physical backlash. The victim is plunged into a state of extreme, mind-numbing lust and physical weakness. This effect stacks, and the only way to cure each layer of this frantic sexual urge is through a thorough lovin' session.
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_SensitivityUp.desc: A hypnotic command that forcibly amplifies all five senses. The victim's mind races, increasing their work and movement speed. However, it also completely ignites their sexual desires, drastically reducing the time until their next lovin' urge.\n\nWhen the effect ends, the bearer suffers from [Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust].
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Mesugaki.label: (Raven) Hypnotic Suggestion: Bratty Taunt (Mesugaki)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Mesugaki.descripti: A personality-altering command that forces the victim to act like a brat, provoking and insulting everyone around them. However, a special neural-wave emission ensures that instead of getting angry, targets feel a surge of affection and an intense urge to sexually conquer the brat.\n\nWhen the effect ends, the bearer suffers from [Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust].
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Diuretic.label: (Raven) Hypnotic Suggestion: Incontinence
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_Diuretic.descripti: The victim's bladder control reflexes have been hijacked. They are trapped in a constant, humiliating state of desperately needing to pee. This extreme anxiety stimulates their glands, doubling their Raven liquid production during sex, and often resulting in embarrassing public leaks.\n\nWhen the effect ends, the bearer suffers from [Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust].
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_DailyBuff.label: (Raven) Hypnotic Suggestion: Total Concentration
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_DailyBuff.descript: A mental block that removes all distractions, forcing the victim into a state of absolute, robotic focus for work and learning.\n\nWhen the effect ends, the bearer suffers from [Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust].
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_CombatBuff.label: (Raven) Hypnotic Suggestion: Killing Machine
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_Hypnosis_CombatBuff.descrip: A combat override that completely severs pain receptors and sharpens dynamic vision, turning the victim into a tireless, emotionless killing machine.\n\nWhen the effect ends, the bearer suffers from [Hypnosis Backlash: Extreme Lust].
